alt.en: People and a bicycle outside a building with large painted slogans calling for Indonesian self-determination, liberty, equality and fraternity.
alt.zh: 几个人与一辆自行车位于建筑外墙旁，墙上大字标语呼吁印尼自决、自由、平等与博爱。

caption.en: Jakarta, then catalogued as Batavia, dated 17 August 1945 by the Australian War Memorial. Political slogans cover a street-level building facade.
caption.zh: 雅加达，馆藏记录使用当时的巴达维亚名称，澳大利亚战争纪念馆标注日期为1945年8月17日。临街建筑外墙涂写政治标语。

interpretation.en: Self-determination, liberty, equality and fraternity appear as public demands on the shopfront. They place the independence struggle in everyday urban space. Armed struggle and diplomacy continued before the 1949 transfer of sovereignty.
interpretation.zh: 自决、自由、平等与博爱成为店面外墙上的公开诉求，把独立斗争带入日常城市空间。此后武装斗争与外交谈判继续，直到1949年主权移交。

title.zh: 贝尔根—贝尔森的幸存者

alt.en: A large group of camp survivors stands beside a wire fence; some wear striped uniforms and several look toward the camera.
alt.zh: 一大群集中营幸存者站在铁丝网旁，部分人穿条纹囚服，数人望向镜头。

caption.en: Bergen-Belsen, Germany, 1945. The Australian War Memorial identifies this group as camp survivors and records liberation by British troops on 15 April 1945. The exact photograph date is not supplied.
caption.zh: 德国贝尔根—贝尔森，1945年。澳大利亚战争纪念馆将这一群体标为集中营幸存者，并记载英军于1945年4月15日解放该营。照片的确切拍摄日期未载。

interpretation.en: People stand close together beside the fence, many looking toward the camera. The catalogue preserves the camp and year but leaves their names and individual stories unrecorded.
interpretation.zh: 人们紧密站在围栏旁，许多人望向镜头。目录留下了营地与年份，却未记录这些人的姓名与个人经历。
